layer_title: Assumptions: costs, revenues and financing the pro-forma uses (dated, cited, refreshed)
note: Every figure here is an assumption, not a rule: the pro-forma is arithmetic over this layer and layer E. A figure with a public, machine-readable source is refreshed by `python -m ffm refresh`, which appends a new dated version; a figure read from a PDF carries a `verify` note and is typed by a person; a figure with no public source is marked `placeholder: true` in its source and the memo says so. Nothing here is invented silently.

rules.title: Hard construction cost, base ($/m², Vancouver)
rules.jurisdiction: BC Ministry of Housing / BC Housing (standardized designs)

params.summary: Hard cost base $4,693 per m² ($436 per build sq ft): the average of the three four-unit wood-frame designs in the Class D estimate for the Province's standardized housing designs, Vancouver baseline, August 2024, hard costs only
params.basis: average of Quadplex 01 ($425/sf), Quadplex 02 ($438/sf) and Townhouse ($446/sf); the catalogue's ten designs run $401 to $585 per build sq ft; the report's regional review gives Vancouver $350 to $475 per sq ft
params.excludes: soft costs, utility connections, existing buildings, rock or shoring, pad-mounted transformers (the report's stated assumptions)

source.title: SHP Class D Estimate Report, V3 (Chris Hill, CPA CMA, for the BC Ministry of Housing Standardized Designs Catalogue), 21 Aug 2024
source.section: Cost Estimate Summary (per build sf); Region Review; Assumptions
source.verify: The catalogue's designs are two- to four-unit, three-storey wood-frame buildings; a six-storey apartment sits outside it. Replace with a quantity surveyor's Class D figure for the actual building type when one exists, and keep this as the floor.
